page.overview:
What is vardarianna?

Vardarianna was one of the Fragrant Trees brought by the Elves from Tol Eressëa to Númenor. They grew in the region called Nísimaldar.

The name Vardarianna might be related to the Vala Varda and the Quenya term rianna ("crown-gift").
